remarks: Corner Unit with wrap around windows flood this immaculate 1 bedroom unit with natural light. This spacious unit offers an open floor plan with a private bedroom, all on one level. The fully equipped kitchen offers stainless steel range, microwave, dishwasher, refrigerator, pantry and breakfast bar that opens to the family room. Spacious bedroom includes a large walk-in closet. Enjoy the amenities that Clocktower has to offer including a fully equipped fitness center, locker rooms and sauna. There are large indoor and outdoor entertainment rooms which include billiards, ping pong and a full kitchen. The lush, peaceful courtyard is an inviting and quiet place to relax. Conveniently located and close to popular restaurants, major highways, public transportation and shopping. * Note* New shades will be installed on all windows.
